newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up, led by Lujiazui.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up, led by Lujiazui.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended up strongly on Monday with institutions buying companies which have a heavy weighting in the index, including Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development, brokers said.
The B share index rose 2.572 points or 2.92 percent to 90.670 points on volume of 42.673 million shares worth $23.875 million, compared with $22.988 million on Friday.
Brokers said both domestic and overseas institutions were seen buying today due to confidence in China's economic prospects after Hong Kong returns to Chinese rule.
"Overseas investors have begun to buy on the basis of good fundamentals and improved confidence in the upward potential of B shares supported by China's economic development," one broker said.
"The index will at least test the 100 point level this time round," another broker said. "Most B shares prices are still very cheap compared with their A shares counterparts."
Of 43 B shares, 41 traded, with 29 up, 12 down.
Shanghai Automation Instrument was the star on its better-than-expected results, surging $0.022 or 9.82 percent to $0.246 on volume of 1.3 million shares.
Shanghai Lujiazui was the third winner on institutional buying, jumping $0.120 or 8.87 percent to $1.472 on volume of 3.2 million shares.
Shanghai Chlor Alkai was the most actively traded on overseas buying, up $0.010 or 2.97 percent to $0.346 on volume of 4.4 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index fell on a technical correction, but trading was active with investors mixed over the market's outlook, brokers said.
The index slipped 15.047 points or 1.05 percent to 1,411.925 on volume of 845.7 million shares worth 11.9 billion yuan.
But The SSE30 blue chip index bucked the market trend on selective institutional buying, jumping 110.681 points or 2.92 percent to 3,904.495 points.
Shanghai United Agriculture was the biggest loser on talk of possible poor results, plunging 1.07 yuan or 10.03 percent to 9.59 yuan on volume of 775,100 shares.
